title: Quality of Life and Life Satisfaction in Pediatric and Adolescent Gymnasts Through Injury
official: Quality of Life and Life Satisfaction in Pediatric and Adolescent Gymnasts Through Injury
summary: This study aims to assess the quality and life and life satisfaction of pediatric and adolescent gymnasts throughout their musculoskeletal injury recovery.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male and female gymnasts ages 8-18 years old
* Participating in Excel or Developmental gymnastics programs who present to Children's Hospital Colorado sports medicine or orthopedic clinics with a musculoskeletal injury.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Gymnasts only participating in Colorado Association for Recreational Athletics (CARA) gymnastics, retired gymnasts, and adult or collegiate gymnasts.
